$comment: Free-for-all territories declared by the Coalition and then the Federation. FFA ground was open to anyone: a capture there is churn, not an act of war. Any claim that reads capture counts as evidence of allegiance or hostility must exclude the FFA territories in force for that window. Sources are Tier A (announcement channels) and quotable. Thirteen declarations are known, January 2018 to September 2019; the two earliest are map images whose territory names were never written in text, so windows before 10 March 2018 can only be bounded, not filtered.
rule: Use the list whose date is on or before the window start. Never borrow a neighbouring month: the lists change size from 12 to 23 across 2018.

lists.note: The Coalition's assignment for thirteen guilds, ending 'Free for all territories are in black.' The FFA ground is only on the image, so no names are recoverable. On 1 February the alliance said further territories would be made free-for-all but that it had not yet chosen which. The announcement was edited on 2018-01-20, so its contents are evidence of what it said on the edit date and of the posting date only by inference. Do not filter a capture falling between the two against it.
Posted as a map image with FFA territories in black; the names are not in the text. Count from the research session. Do not substitute a neighbouring list.
Plus 7 listed as "available for the future (FFA for now)" — unassigned and equally free to take.

The announcement was edited on 2018-03-27, so its contents are evidence of what it said on the edit date and of the posting date only by inference. Do not filter a capture falling between the two against it.

The announcement was edited on 2018-04-27, so its contents are evidence of what it said on the edit date and of the posting date only by inference. Do not filter a capture falling between the two against it.
Amended after publication on 2018-08-05, so it was in force as amended rather than unchanged until the next declaration. Territory names for the amendments are not held here.
Amended after publication on 2018-09-11, so it was in force as amended rather than unchanged until the next declaration. Territory names for the amendments are not held here.
Published as a map image with the free-for-all ground shown rather than listed, so no names are recoverable. Supersedes the 6 August text list for any window from this date.

The list in force through the Confederation offensive and collapse. The message was edited on 11 September 2018, so the text in the archived document is the 11 September version, not what was posted on the 8th. Figures filtered against it for windows from the 14th onward are unaffected in substance; a claim about what the alliance declared ON the 8th is not supported by it. Amended on 11 September 2018, when Thesead was assigned to a member guild and ceased to be free-for-all — announced in the alliance channel, which is why the message carries an edit of that date.

A full census on one sheet: sixteen guilds holding 369 assigned territories plus sixteen free-for-all, totalling 385 — the number of distinct territories the capture log records changing hands between 30 March and 8 October 2018. The sheet captions seventeen free-for-all and lists sixteen. Borne on an image; no names recoverable.

Published to the Federation public announcements channel and edited on 2 November 2018, so the archived text is the November version. Differs from 8 September by adding Thesead, Bandit's Toll and Battle Tower and dropping Thanos.

Terra, published a week after it won the map and maintained in the same channel until at least December 2019 — so the institution did not lapse after 2018. The eighteen names are NOT held here: this file is tracked and public, and while the territory names are public game geography, the declaration itself (this alliance, these territories, this date) is archive content from a channel that is not one of the thirteen sanctioned exports. The list lives in the research vault. To filter a 2019 window, send the research session the distinct territories in it with their exchange counts and it returns raw, free-for-all and contested totals; nothing of the archive moves. Amended after publication on 2019-09-30, 2019-10-10, 2019-11-15, 2019-12-11, so it was in force as amended rather than unchanged until the next declaration. Territory names for the amendments are not held here.

amendmentNote: A declaration was in force AS AMENDED. At least six dated amendments are known — two by the Federation in 2018 and four by Terra between September and December 2019 — and only the announcement tier was searched, so amendments agreed in a leadership channel and never published are not counted. ffa-filter.mjs applies a declaration unchanged and therefore reports a slightly stale list for any window after an amendment; it warns when it is doing so.
